name: bibtex-reference-manager-mcp
description: BibTeX reference manager MCP server for AI apps. Parse, convert, dedupe and lint BibTeX, RIS and CSL JSON reference lists and make cite keys. Works offline, no account.

tools.name: parse_bibliography
tools.description: Read BibTeX, RIS or CSL JSON text and return normalized entries. Example: parse a BibTeX article and get authors as "Family, Given" with lower case fields.

tools.name: convert_bibliography
tools.description: Convert between BibTeX, RIS, CSL JSON and plain text. Example: convert BibTeX to RIS while cleaning page ranges and DOIs.

tools.name: dedupe_entries
tools.description: Find duplicate references by DOI, title similarity and cite key. Example: two entries with same DOI keep the one with more fields and drop the other.

tools.name: lint_entries
tools.description: Flag missing fields, bad page ranges, uncapitalized titles and invalid DOIs. Example: an article missing journal returns a missing-field issue.

tools.name: generate_cite_keys
tools.description: Create consistent cite keys like smith2024deep. Example: Smith 2024 "Deep Learning" becomes smith2024deep with repeated keys getting letters.
